profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I'm a member of the Cloud Firestore control plane team which handles all things involved in deciding whether to and how to fulfill a customer request, including billing, auth, rules integration, and logging. My work focuses on building efficient batch processing pipelines for billing as well as database statistics and insights. Previously I have worked on authorization and authentication for requests to Google APIs. 

Former engineer resident in a one year rotational program for newly graduated software engineers consisting of eight weeks of training in Google tools, technologies and best practices followed by two rotations on Google engineering teams.
First rotation: Cloud Firestore
Second rotation: Android Automotive Embedded

positions.title: CS 161 (Computer Security) Undergraduate Student Instructor
positions.description:
I led and taught students in weekly discussion sections and office hours.

The class focuses on an introduction to computer security. Cryptography, including encryption, authentication, hash functions, cryptographic protocols, and applications. Network security, firewalls, viruses, and worms. Software security, defensive programming, and language-based security.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Tested software and wrote simulations for the QoS Manager of the Triton UAV communications system in C++.  I also made a visualization script that tracks Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIG) records for the Triton cybersecurity team.

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Intern
positions.description: Developed edge detection software in OpenCV and Tensorflow to create an object detection algorithm to scan for the presence of foreign objects on the F/A-18 manufacturing line.

allTitles: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Intern
